description: This file defines the PassengerRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to manage Passenger entities in the database. It includes custom query methods for searching passengers by phone number and email.

classes.name: PassengerRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Passenger entity providing standard CRUD operations and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByPhoneE164
methods.description: Finds a Passenger by their phone number in E164 format.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a Passenger by their email address.
